assessments.reasoning: Section 5.4.4.1 at p.97 resets Err and selects the Resume Next policy for the current procedure activation. The matching policy row on p.96 gives in-activation continuation at the ordinarily following statement when that policy handles the error.

challenge.method: Compare the p.96 policy table, the p.97 On Error statement, and distinct p.98 Resume statement. Compare the default and direct host-invocation initial policies and test whether the claim would conclude a branch for Resume 0.
challenge.results: The p.98 literal-zero branches overlap for the separate Resume statement. The selected statement explicitly chooses its own activation policy and the p.96 table determines the bounded result when applied. Default, Terminate, and other propagation cases are separate.

limitations: This judgment applies to the exact May 20, 2025 MS-VBAL revision 2.4. The publisher currently lists a later edition. Its requirements and behavior of any Office host are outside this review.
The continuation is conditional on this policy applying to the error in the same activation. Host error reporting and the distinct Resume statement are excluded.
